# Barkbus

> > Luxury mobile dog grooming service bringing award-winning grooming directly to your home across Southern California and beyond.

Barkbus operates a fleet of mobile grooming units staffed by certified, experienced groomers trained in Pet First Aid and CPR. The company serves multiple locations across California including Los Angeles, Orange County, and the Bay Area, with a commitment to stress-free, convenient pet grooming.
